observations: White chest freezer with a top-opening lid.
The interior walls are made of silver-colored metal.
The interior base is divided into two sections.
The lid features a circular vent and several circular indentations.
The exterior shows significant rust and peeling paint at the bottom edge.
A control panel with a power switch and a dial is visible on the front.
The rear view shows the cooling coils and a power cord.
A sticker on the front identifies the brand as 'Haier Thermocool'.
A sticker on the back contains a technical specification label.

claims.evidence: The capacity is not stated on the visible labels.

risks.risk: The unit may not cool or may have a faulty compressor.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit plugged in and the interior frost forming.

risks.risk: The cooling coils may be clogged with dust or debris.
risks.proof: A photo of the coils with the protective grille removed.

risks.risk: The compressor may be leaking refrigerant.
risks.proof: A video of the unit running with a thermometer showing a drop in temperature.

proof_requests: Video of the freezer plugged in and running.
Photo of the technical specification label on the back to confirm the model and capacity.
Photo of the coils with the grille removed to check for dirt.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
